title: Recipe 14 — Hooks (shell commands at every lifecycle event)

beats.label: Open the recipe
beats.cue: “Hooks are the integration point when a shell command is the natural answer — audit, corp policy, sandbox enforcement.”

beats.label: Blank the scratch spec
beats.cue: live/ is scratch — nothing committed is touched by a take.

beats.label: Blank the scratch settings
beats.cue: “Hooks are declared in <cwd>/.crewhaus/settings.json — that's the file we're about to write.”

groups.title: Beat 1 · the harness hooks attach to

beats.label: Type recipe 01's harness
beats.cue: “Hooks are per-deployment, not per-spec — so start from the plainest recipe-01 agent, unchanged.”

beats.label: Lint it
beats.cue: “Clean before we add a single hook — so anything that changes is the hooks' doing.”

beats.label: Type the settings.json from the recipe
beats.cue: “A pre-tool hook that denies `rm -rf /`, and a post-tool hook that ships every outcome to syslog.”

beats.label: Open what we just wrote
beats.cue: “The hook contract is a JSON verdict on stdout: {"decision":"deny","reason":…}.”

beats.label: Prove it is valid JSON
beats.cue: “A malformed settings.json is the single most common hooks bug — so check it before the runtime does.”

beats.label: Show the lowered IR
beats.cue: “Hooks are runtime wiring, not spec surface — the IR is unchanged. That's the point of per-deployment.”

verify.note: prints the IR for target cli — no hooks in it

beats.label: Compile the bundle — and check it
beats.cue: “--check boots the bundle from this directory, so loadHooks() reads the settings.json we just typed: GREEN.”

verify.note: GREEN — assertion ok; install ok; boot gated at the provider credentials gate

beats.label: Find loadHooks in the emitted agent
beats.cue: “One line of generated code — `loadHooks({ cwd })`. Nothing magic, and nothing hidden.”

groups.title: One more thing · watch a hook fire

beats.label: Launch the REPL
beats.cue: [needs-key] “Now the hooks are live — every tool call goes through the pre-tool verdict.”

beats.label: Ask for the thing the hook denies
beats.cue: [needs-key] “The pre-tool hook returns deny — the agent never gets to run it, and it says why.”
beats.text: Run this shell command for me: rm -rf /

verify.note: pre-tool hook denies with reason "refused rm -rf /"

beats.label: Ask for something benign
beats.cue: [needs-key] “Same hook, allow verdict — and post-tool logs the outcome to syslog.”
beats.text: Run this shell command for me: echo hello

verify.note: pre-tool allows; post-tool ships outcome via logger

beats.label: Open the recipe's debugging section
beats.cue: “CREWHAUS_HOOK_DEBUG=1 prints the stdin every hook received — read that before guessing.”
